name: crmbuilder
description: Modular CRM builder for small businesses — offline-first PWA with optional cloud sync.
comment:overrides: express 4.22.2 — the last of the 4.x line — pins qs ~6.15.1, and both moderate qs advisories (array-limit bypass via bracket-key comma parsing, and DoS via attacker-controlled isBuffer) are fixed in 6.16.0. So `npm audit fix` can move body-parser and CANNOT move express: the range forbids it. qs parses req.query on every request here (express 4 defaults the query parser to 'extended'), so this is reachable on every route rather than theoretical. 6.16.0 is a minor bump inside the same major and the tilde is the maintainer's caution rather than a known incompatibility. Express 5 pins a fixed qs and is the real answer; it is not a change to make inside a security patch. Remove this override when express moves. CLAUDE.md §61 R5.
